column4: Private npm registry auth token committed in .npmrc and packages/functions/.npmrc
Six Firestore collections are open to any caller and none are scoped by shopId
Six collections are world-readable (three also world-writable) and are read directly by the browser Firebase SDK
bulkGenerateProcesses, resultGen and analytics are read AND write `if true`
credits, historySyncData and translateProcesses are read `if true` with no shopId scoping
Deploy-queue release bearer token inlined into the client bundle via a VITE_ env var
Deploy-board bearer token is baked into the staging frontend bundle
Shared Avada SEO cross-app integration token is bundled into the React app and sent from every merchant's browser
Shared Avada SEO Pro integration token is imported into the React bundle and sent from the merchant's browser
Second copy of the private npm registry auth token
Hardcoded Google Translate API key in the Translate client constructor
Cross-app SEO integration token hardcoded in tracked source
Flow extension endpoints are unauthenticated and trust client-supplied shopify_domain
Flow extension endpoints have no auth and take the target shop from `shopify_domain` in the body.
isRegenerate branch of POST /generate mutates and deletes another shop's process with no ownership check
POST /generate isRegenerate branch mutates a process by client-supplied id with no ownership check
Bulk refund basis is computed from the body's `model`, independent of what was actually charged — mints credits
PUT /settings spreads the request body unfiltered, so a body-supplied shopId re-parents the settings document
`PUT /shop` lets the client set its own `noLimit`, `enablePro`, `enableGpt41`
PUT /shop lets a shop set noLimit and enablePro on itself

PUT /shop lets any merchant self-grant noLimit / enablePro / enableGpt41 from the request body

GET /syncData/:shopifyDomain runs a full sync against whatever shop the URL names, not the session shop
Shopify `shpua_` user access token committed as the `process.env.ACCESS_TOKEN` default

creditCost is read from the request body and used as both the balance gate and the amount charged
creditCost is taken from the request body and only type-checked, never recomputed server-side
Merchant integration key is accepted from the URL query string on an unauthenticated route
Shopify webhook HMAC check is commented out. `webhookCreateProduct` and `webhookBulkOperation` accept any POST.

Webhook HMAC verification is commented out — `verifyWebhook` calls `next()` unconditionally
syncProducts subscriber re-publishes the same raw shop doc once per pagination page
createProcess spreads the client body after shopId, letting the caller overwrite the process owner
